summary: Covers the plain-text side of data detection (links, dates, addresses, phone numbers) and a QR-only camera scanner inside the system Camera app. No image analysis (Live Text, text recognition in images), no subject lifting, no Visual Look Up, no document scanning and no SDK API for camera scanning.

features.feature: Barcode and QR scanning through the camera
features.note: Wave 5 (w5-visionkit, parity/integration 93f283b0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Pure-Rust decoder for QR model 2 codes only (versions 1-10, all masks and EC levels), no perspective correction. Used only by the system Camera app; no SDK API for apps and no other barcode symbologies. Built 2026-10-17: DataScanner also reads EAN-13 and Code 39 barcodes from sample rows (bifrost_ui::barcode::decode_row) when a frame has no QR code; the 1D encoders moved to pub render_modules and ean13_modules; tests data_scanner::tests (ean13_barcode_in_the_frame_is_one_item).

features.feature: Live text scanning through the camera
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 19 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No text recognition (OCR) code exists in the repo. The triage search for ocr, tesseract and live text returned nothing.

features.feature: Text recognition and selection in images
features.apple: ImageAnalyzer, ImageAnalysis, ImageAnalysisInteraction, ImageAnalysisOverlayView (text selection, copy)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 19 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Images cannot be analysed for text. Photos and Notes have no text-in-image selection.

features.feature: Data detectors in recognized image text
features.apple: ImageAnalysisInteraction (data detectors: URLs, phone numbers, dates, tracking numbers)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 15 tests. Detection works on plain text only: links, dates, street addresses and phone numbers, with no transit information and no image text. Notes taps open links; Contacts does not use it.

features.apple: ImageAnalysisInteraction.Subject, ImageAnalysis subjects, subject extraction to a separate image
features.note: Subject lists, hit testing, highlights and cutouts are tested headless, and a colour-key segmenter lifts a subject off a plain backdrop (background_removal_* in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-13.rs). Gap: there is no learned segmentation model for busy scenes, and the module is not wired into the shell or apps, so it is not yet checked on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: the SDK re-exports the colour-key segmenter as bifrost_app::image_analysis::segment_background, and Preview's Tools > Lift Subject replaces the picture with the subject cut out of a plain backdrop (apps/preview-desktop pixels::lift_subject); tests image_analysis::tests (the_colour_key_finds_the_subject_on_a_plain_backdrop) and pixels::tests (lift_subject_crops_to_the_subject_with_a_transparent_backdrop). Still no learned segmentation model.

Audit 2026-10-13: the row predated this code. Pure model with host unit tests (visual_lookup.rs, look_up.rs, visual_search.rs); not wired into the shell or apps, not tested on Midget. The only Look Up reference in springboard/src/shell/pages.rs:868 is the dictionary list used by the keyboard. It is not an image lookup.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 19 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The Camera app takes photos, a timer and QR scans. It has no page-by-page document mode and no edge detection; the JPEG path is springboard/src/shell/camera/jpeg.rs.

The stabilizer keeps the region inside the frame, ignores moves inside its dead band, closes half the distance per frame, and clamps when the frame size changes; all of it is tested headless. Gap: no view draws the stabilised region of the camera feed and no app or shell feeds it frames, so the live behaviour needs the camera on the lab machine.

features.feature: Image analysis overlay and delegate callbacks
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 19 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No overlay view for images in the SDK. Views are in springboard/sdk/src/view/.

gaps: No text recognition (OCR) for camera frames or images, so Live Text, DataScanner text and ImageAnalyzer have no counterpart.
No document scanning mode (VNDocumentCameraViewController equivalent) in the Camera app or in the SDK.
No subject lifting or background removal for images.
Camera scanning exists only inside the system Camera app for QR model 2 codes. It has no SDK API and no other barcode formats.
Plain-text data detection (controls::detect) has no image counterpart and does not cover transit information.
